preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode object representing the root of a binary tree.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root.left, root.right] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: If root is not None, its left and right children must either be None or valid TreeNode objects.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for node in subtree_nodes if all(node.val == subtree_root.val for subtree_root in subtree_roots(node)))
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of all subtrees where every node in the subtree has the same value as the subtree's root. A subtree is defined as a node and all its descendants.
The returned count is a non-negative integer.
